## Library Loading

```{r}
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
```

## Data Loading

```{r}
# Define path to the data folder
data_dir <- here("data")

# Increase read_csv buffer size
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = "5000000")

# Load the three augmented datasets
donor_df   <- read_csv(str_c(data_dir, "/04_donor_metadata_aug.csv"))
protein_df <- read_csv(str_c(data_dir, "/04_protein_data_aug.csv"))
rnaseq_df  <- read_csv(str_c(data_dir, "/04_rnaseq_data_aug.csv.gz"))
```

## Data Description

After cleaning and filtering in 03_clean , the three final datasets have the following dimensions:

```{r}
# Summary table comparing total rows, columns, and unique donors across datasets
tibble(
  dataset = c("Donor metadata", "Protein data", "RNA-seq data"),
  total_rows = c(nrow(donor_df), nrow(protein_df), nrow(rnaseq_df)),
  total_cols = c(ncol(donor_df), ncol(protein_df), ncol(rnaseq_df)),
  unique_donors = c(
    n_distinct(donor_df$donor_id),
    n_distinct(protein_df$donor_id),
    n_distinct(rnaseq_df$donor_id)
  )
)
```

a\) Donor metadata

```{r}
# Count total donors per study group
donor_counts <- donor_df |>
  count(group_label, name = "number_donors") |>
  mutate(percentage_donors = round(100 * number_donors / sum(number_donors), 1))  # calculate percentage

# Final row with total count across all groups
donor_counts |>
  bind_rows(
    donor_counts |>
      summarise(
        group_label = "Total",
        number_donors = sum(number_donors),
        percentage_donors = sum(percentage_donors)
      )
  )
```

Every group represents between 20.4% and 31.2% of the cohort (noAD_noTBI is the largest with 29 donors and AD_TBI is the smallest with 19).

```{r}
# Summarize key demographic, genetic, and neuropathology variables per group
donor_df |>
  group_by(group_label) |>
  summarise(
    number_donors = n(),
    number_female = sum(sex == "F", na.rm = TRUE),
    number_male = sum(sex == "M", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_edu_yrs = median(education_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage_apoe4_pos = round(100 * mean(apo_e4_allele == "Y", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_braak = median(braak, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cerad = median(cerad, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_nia_reagan = median(nia_reagan, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Check the number and percentage of NAs in each column
donor_df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "column",
    values_to = "number_na"
  ) |>
  mutate(percentage_na = round(100 * number_na / nrow(donor_df), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(number_na))
```

b\) Protein data

```{r}
# Count protein tissue samples by study group and brain region
protein_counts <- protein_df |>
  count(group_label, structure_acronym) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = structure_acronym,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(total = FWM + HIP)

# Add a final row showing total samples for FWM, HIP, and all
protein_counts |>
  bind_rows(
    protein_counts |>
      summarise(
        group_label = "Total",
        FWM = sum(FWM),
        HIP = sum(HIP),
        total = sum(total)
      )
  )
```

```{r}
# Surviving protein columns and remaining NAs
protein_df |>
  select(-c(donor_id, structure_acronym, group_label)) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "protein",
    values_to = "number_na"
  ) |>
  mutate(percentage_na = round(100 * number_na / nrow(protein_df), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(number_na))
```

c\) RNA-seq data

```{r}
# Count RNA-seq tissue samples by study group and brain region (FWM vs HIP)
rnaseq_counts <- rnaseq_df |>
  count(group_label, structure_acronym) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = structure_acronym,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(total = FWM + HIP)

# Add a final row showing total samples for FWM, HIP, and overall
rnaseq_counts |>
  bind_rows(
    rnaseq_counts |>
      summarise(
        group_label = "Total",
        FWM = sum(FWM),
        HIP = sum(HIP),
        total = sum(total)
      )
  )
```

```{r}
# Summarize gene count and check for any NAs in the RNA-seq dataset
tibble(
  total_samples = nrow(rnaseq_df),
  total_cols = ncol(rnaseq_df),
  n_genes = ncol(rnaseq_df) - 3, # excluding donor_id, structure_acronym and group_label
  total_na = sum(is.na(rnaseq_df))
)
```

```{r}
# View the first 6 columns
glimpse(rnaseq_df[, 1:6])
```

The preview confirms that rnaseq_df has 149 tissue-sample rows, starting with the three sample identifiers (donor_id, structure_acronym, and group_label), where the same donor can appear twice if both HIP and FWM samples are present.

The remaining columns contain numeric (dbl) normalized FPKM expression values, including many zeros as expected for lowly expressed or unexpressed genes.
